name: Golgothian Sylex
description: An artifact so powerful that Urza's activation of it devastated Dominaria.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod wounds and captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains, takes the sylex and interrogates her in Almaaz.
timeline.quote: Near the Colekgan Mountains , Ashnod wounded and captured Loran, and relieved her of the sylex.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, slaughtering both armies and sinking Argoth, which ignites his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles, sank the sub-continent of Argoth

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, ending the Brothers' War and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on a completely ravaged Argoth.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
timeline.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon receives the Golgothian Sylex and Coral Helm from the Yumok and learns magic from Hurkyl.
timeline.quote: He also started learning magic from Hurkyl , eventually learning to tap into the red mana of his mountain home.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon sends Loran away with the Golgothian Sylex since his lame leg would slow her; she is captured by Ashnod and tortured.
timeline.quote: Loran did as she was bid, but she was captured by Ashnod who tortured her

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast is triggered and Feldon and Loran realize the war is over.
timeline.quote: Feldon and Loran realized the war was finally over.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "After the Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yumok fishermen accidentally net the Sylex in 36 AR and send it to Feldon in Terisia City.
timeline.quote: The Sylex was accidentally netted by Yumok fishermen in 36 AR , and sent to Feldon in Terisia City for study.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loran flees Terisia City with the Sylex, but is later wounded, captured and relieved of it by Ashnod.
timeline.quote: She was later wounded, captured, and relieved of the sylex by Ashnod .

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, who conveys it and its detonation process to Urza.
timeline.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it and its detonation process to Urza.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In remorse, Urza performs the Sylex's ritual with his blood, grief and pain and activates it.
timeline.quote: He spoke the words of the inscription, and the sylex activated.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Yumok deliver the Sylex to Feldon; Feldon and Loran feel darkness on touching it.
timeline.quote: they felt a darkness come over them as if the sun had fallen behind an eclipse

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of Terisia City, Loran escapes with the Sylex but is caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who captures her.
timeline.quote: The avalanche had been triggered by Ashnod, who discovered the Sylex and took both it and Loran into captivity.

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at Argoth, Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos while she holds Gix back.
timeline.quote: They were attacked by Gix , but Ashnod passed the Sylex to Tawnos

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Argoth is obliterated when Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex in the last battle.
timeline.quote: Completely obliterated in the last battle of the War, when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex .

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, destroying both armies, sinking Argoth and leading to the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles around, sank the sub-continent Argoth

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex the climate cools, crops fail, and strife breaks out between former allies; homarids encroach on merfolk waters.
timeline.quote: After Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , the climate of the entire world rapidly cooled.

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Climate Change". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel threatens annihilation with the Golgothian Sylex and forces the sages into an oath of non-interference.
timeline.quote: he forced the sages to submit to his will

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jared destroys the Golgothian Sylex with the Rust Daggers.
timeline.quote: Jared has the Rust Daggers and uses them to cast a Shatter spell on the Sylex, destroying it.

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 5: Dark Eminence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra conquers Sarinth while Urza annexes Korlis and Sardia, and Ashnod obtains the Golgothian Sylex at Terisia City.
timeline.quote: Ashnod obtains a Thran artifact called the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Sylex and sacrifices herself to delay Gix.
timeline.quote: Ashnod delays him long enough to let Tawnos escape at the cost of her life

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza releases the Sylex's energy, destroying Argoth and obliterating both armies.
timeline.quote: the resulting explosion destroys Argoth

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, obliterating Argoth and forming the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, which again blocks the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: The plans to defeat Urza were foiled when he activated the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In truth Ramos, a dragon engine crafted by Urza, gathers victims when the Golgothian Sylex is activated and is sent through a Phyrexian portal to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Ramos was merely a dragon engine crafted by Urza to battle Mishra and save those caught in the battlefield.

citation.text: "Mercadia", section "The Myth of Ramos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, devastating Dominaria; the resulting Shard keeps the Phyrexians out and Yawgmoth has Gix imprisoned in the 7th Sphere.
timeline.quote: A furious Yawgmoth had Gix thrown into the 7th Sphere of Phyrexia, where he would be tortured for all eternity.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel detonates a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities to protect planes connected to New Phyrexia, potentially causing a Multiversal spark rupture.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel detonated a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Within the rift the group witnesses the events that caused Dominaria's rifts, including the Sylex and the obliteration of Tolaria.
timeline.quote: they witness the devastating events in Dominaria's history that caused the rifts plaguing the plane

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn digs up the Sylex in Yavimaya, planning to use it against New Phyrexia, then hides it in Jhoira's closet on the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: Karn dug up the Sylex in Yavimaya , planning to use it to destroy New Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Retrieval and certain destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the assault on the Thran Mana Rig, the compleated Ajani crumples the Sylex and takes a disabled Karn to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the compleated Ajani crumpled the Sylex and took a disabled Karn to New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Retrieval and certain destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower to travel back to the Brothers' War to learn how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: to travel back in time to the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Teferi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth grabs the Sylex and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Elspeth grabs it before it can trigger fully and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The excavator opens a sealed Thran workshop, and Karn finds a diagram of the sylex and a clay tablet with matching symbols.
timeline.quote: a diagram of the sylex painted on parchment

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn returns to camp, where Jhoira's unanswered letters lie, and examines the sylex, which shocks him.
timeline.quote: The sylex sent a jolt through him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn secretly moves the sylex from his room to Jhoira's workshop on the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He stowed the sylex and its case on the lowest shelf behind lengths of pipe

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Believing he will die, Karn generates a titanium and carbon casing around the distant sylex to protect it.
timeline.quote: He spun the densest carbon filaments he could from the aether and encased the sylex in its lockbox in titanium.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani crumples the sylex in his hand, destroying it.
timeline.quote: he lifted the sylex—and crumpled it in his hand, as if the ancient artifact were made of nothing more than paper.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira triggers the Rig's self-destruction; the Golgothian Sylex is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Jhoira triggered the Rig's self-destruction to prevent its capture

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisia City falls after a siege; Feldon and Loran flee with the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: The Third Path suffered heavy losses during the Fall of Terisia City

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
timeline.quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In a void at the sylex's blast, Teferi tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker and the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: I need to tell you some things about the future,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
timeline.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza pours his love, grief and hatred into the Sylex, shaking the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Urza poured his love, his grief, and his hatred into the Sylex, and the Multiverse shook.

citation.text: Urza's Ruinous Blast (The Brothers' War Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The sylex blast razes the land and leaves Urza alone in the silence.
timeline.quote: Urza stood alone in the sudden silence.

citation.text: Calamity's Wake (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As Terisia City burns, Feldon presses the sylex into Loran's hands and urges her to run.
timeline.quote: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run.

citation.text: Loran's Escape (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashnod tells Tawnos to get the sylex to Urza at any cost.
timeline.quote: "Get the sylex to Urza at any cost.

citation.text: Fateful Handoff (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth bursts in, impales Jace with her halo-infused blade, seizes the Sylex and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: burst into the chamber, impaled Jace with her halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "The averted blast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza uses the Golgothian Sylex to obliterate Mishra and his army, levels Argoth, and becomes a planeswalker as the stones merge into his eyes.
timeline.quote: Urza used the Golgothian Sylex to obliterate his brother and his army.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Reunification in Urza, Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi travels back in time with Saheeli's device to find how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: Teferi enlisted Saheeli to develop a device in Urza's Tower

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi learns the Sylex is triggered by a person and is lost in the time stream when the Anchor is damaged.
timeline.quote: it was not a spell or artifact but a person who activated it

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, obliterating Argoth, and becomes a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex , obliterating Argoth

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Brothers' War (20 AR to 64 AR) [ 16 ] [ 50 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gixians betray the Third Path; Hurkyl dies defending Terisia City and Loran flees with the Sylex.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl dies defending the city.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains and takes the Sylex.
timeline.quote: Loran is captured by Ashnod near the Colekgan Mountains.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Gix drives artifact creatures mad, Ashnod hands the Sylex to Tawnos, who gives it to Urza, and Mishra is revealed as altered by Phyrexian constructs.
timeline.quote: Mishra is revealed to have been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg to swamp and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age; Urza ascends and Gix retreats to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza activates the Sylex.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya watches an illusion vanish: Jace holds the real Sylex and activates it before phyresis claims his mind.
timeline.quote: Jace held the real Sylex—and had activated it before phyresis claimed his mind.

citation.text: Bring the Ending (Phyrexia: All Will Be One, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth takes a detonating Sylex off New Phyrexia, ending the covert mission in failure.
timeline.quote: Elspeth took a detonating Sylex off the plane, marking the end of the Gatewatch's mission as a failure

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace prepares to activate the Sylex at Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Jace prepared to activate the Sylex

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.
timeline.quote: impaled Jace with her Halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, broken open, urges the strike force to detonate the Sylex, and Koth offers to free him.
timeline.quote: Still able to talk, he encouraged the strike force to detonate the Sylex.

citation.text: "Karn", section "Return to New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya allows Jace to telepathically extract the Sylex information from her.
timeline.quote: she allowed Jace Beleren to telepathically extract this information from her

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins the strike team to infiltrate New Phyrexia and destroy Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Kaya joined the strike team that was to infiltrate New Phyrexia and detonate the Sylex to destroy Realmbreaker

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Kaito try to interrupt Jace's detonation; Elspeth impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.
timeline.quote: burst into the chamber, impaled Jace with her Halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The compleated Ajani reveals his Phyrexian nature, kills Jaya Ballard, captures Karn and destroys the Sylex.
timeline.quote: revealed his new Phyrexian nature, killed Jaya Ballard

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Sheoldred on Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi witnesses the Sylex Blast and learns a person is needed to activate the Sylex.
timeline.quote: found out that it was a person, not a spell or an artifact, that could activate the Sylex

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace tries to detonate the Sylex and fights the incompleat planeswalkers; Elspeth stabs him with Luxior and takes the Sylex.
timeline.quote: Elspeth stabbed Jace with Luxior and picked up the Sylex

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex explodes as Elspeth tries to planeswalk, sending both outside the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: it exploded, sending itself and Elspeth outside the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli re-creates the Golgothian Sylex and, with Teferi and Kaya, builds the Temporal Anchor to find a solution in the past.
timeline.quote: she built the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower .

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth impales Jace with Luxior and disappears with the Sylex.
timeline.quote: only to see Elspeth impale Jace with Luxior and disappear alongside the Sylex

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Against New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn captures Karn, destroys the Sylex and plans the invasion.
timeline.quote: Having captured their errant "father" and destroyed the Sylex, Elesh Norn put the final plans into motion

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Conquering the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sylex blast ends the war and the Dominaria most knew.
timeline.quote: The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it.

citation.text: Llanowar Wastes (Bloomburrow Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The sylex blast ends the war.
timeline.quote: The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war

citation.text: Llanowar Wastes (Duskmourn: House of Horror Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jared uses the Rust Daggers to cast Shatter on the Golgothian Sylex, destroying it.
timeline.quote: destroying it and preventing the annihilation of Corondor

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast nearly wipes Argoth from the map and throws Dominaria into an Ice Age.
timeline.quote: threw Dominaria into an Ice Age

citation.text: "Argoth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Citanul is obliterated with Argoth when Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: Citanul was obliterated along with the rest of Argoth in the last battle of the Brothers' War

citation.text: "Citanul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgothian Sylex detonates, dramatically shifting Dominaria's climate with shorter summers, harsher winters and destructive storms.
timeline.quote: Summers grew shorter, winters harsher, and storms became frequent and destructive.

citation.text: "Dark Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon, aided by Loran, secretly smuggles the Golgothian Sylex out another way.
timeline.quote: Feldon was aided by Loran in secretly smuggling the Golgothian Sylex out

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon gives the Sylex to Loran to flee with.
timeline.quote: so he gave it to Loran and asked her to flee with him on her quick legs

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loran is later captured by Ashnod, who takes the Sylex but keeps it from Mishra.
timeline.quote: she was later captured by Ashnod

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel interrupts a summit of mages and planeswalkers, threatening them with the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: This gathering was interrupted by Ravidel

citation.text: "Liana of Minorad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Yumok fish up the Coral Helm and Golgothian Sylex from the meltwater.
